content: coffee A controlled explosion on a film set near the O2 arena in London ignited a fire that destroyed a van and damaged a car and a lorry. Firefighters were called to an open‑air yard on Dock Road in Silvertown just before 8 p.m. on Saturday, and after about an hour the blaze was brought under control by roughly twenty‑five crews, with no injuries reported. The incident followed a pre‑planned filming event close to the venue that hosts upcoming shows by Niall Horan and Texas. London Fire Brigade posted on X that the fire was now under control, noting the loss of the van and the damage to the car and lorry, and confirming no injuries. They added that the blaze stemmed from the controlled explosion that spread unexpectedly, and crews would stay on site for the rest of the evening. The yard is also close to the Thames cable car link, and a Metropolitan Police spokesman said they were aware of reports of explosions heard near the O2 in Greenwich.
